📋 WHAT WAS INSTALLED:
  ✓ .github/workflows/deploy-workers.yml (GitHub Actions workflow)
  ✓ .github/workflows/README.md (Detailed docs)
  ✓ .github/SETUP.md (Step-by-step setup)

🚀 QUICK START (3 steps):

1. GET CLOUDFLARE API TOKEN
   → https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
   → Create Token → "Edit Cloudflare Workers" template
   → Copy the token

2. ADD TO GITHUB SECRETS
   → https://github.com/soundfactorynyc/SFCHAT4/settings/secrets/actions
   → New repository secret
   → Name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
   → Value: [paste token]

3. PUSH TO GITHUB
   git add .github/
   git commit -m "Add GitHub Actions for Cloudflare Workers"
   git push origin main

   🎉 Your workers will deploy automatically!

📊 WATCH DEPLOYMENTS:
   → https://github.com/soundfactorynyc/SFCHAT4/actions

🔄 AUTO-DEPLOYS ON PUSH TO:
   • sponsorship-api/
   • membership-party-automation/
   • US/

📚 NEED HELP?
   Read: .github/SETUP.md (step-by-step)
   Read: .github/workflows/README.md (detailed docs)
